Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

FITTING DIMENSIONS FOR DENTAL 
BURS AND CUTTERS 



( Reaffirmed 2006 )

1. Scope — Fitting dimensions for dental burs and cutters. 

2. Classification — Burs and cutters covered by this standard shall be classified into following three 
types, according to their shank design: 

Type 1 —With shank designed for use in angle handpieces latch-type; 
Type 2 — With shank designed for use in straight handpieces; and 
Type 5 — With shank designed for use in friction grip handpieces, 

3. Fitting Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

All dimensions in millimetres. 
DENTAL BURS AND CUTTERS, FITTING DIMENSIONS 



4. Measurement for Fitting Dimensions 

4.1 Shank Diameters— Measurement shall be made with tungsten carbide ring gauges checked 
regularly with mating plugs, with air gauges or with diai indicators ( 1/1 000 mm dial ). 

4.2 Other Dimensions — Measurements shall be made with appropriate gauges with tungsten carbide 
faces, with tungsten carbide-faced micrometer calipers, with tooimakers microscopes or with dial 
indicators. 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 
This standard is based on ISO/R 1797-1970 'Dental burs and cutters — Fitting dimensions'.
